cases.steps: Enter manager and the seeded test password; sign in.
cases.expected: Overview opens with manager controls.

cases.steps: Sign in as warehouse. Open Products and Adjustments.
cases.expected: Catalog creation is absent; adjustment creation is disabled.

cases.steps: Submit empty login; then use a nonexistent identity and wrong password.
cases.expected: Inline required errors and generic invalid-login error; no workspace.

cases.steps: Enter a password; toggle Show password then Hide password.
cases.expected: Input changes text/password type without changing the value.

cases.steps: Submit short username, invalid email, weak or over-72-byte password via API.
cases.expected: 400; no accepted invalid signup.

cases.steps: Enter otherwise valid fields with differing confirmation.
cases.expected: Passwords do not match; form is retained.

cases.steps: Create account with valid details. Inspect response and user record.
cases.expected: Verification required, STAFF/PENDING/unverified, no session cookie.

cases.steps: Submit the same username/email again.
cases.expected: 409 with a useful duplicate-record message.

cases.steps: Include role=MANAGER in registration payload.
cases.expected: 400; public signup cannot grant manager permissions.

cases.steps: Create account; inspect local inbox and the verification screen.
cases.expected: Six-digit mail code, local-mode notice, resend countdown disabled.

cases.steps: Submit correct email/code with the wrong account password.
cases.expected: 400; email stays unverified.

cases.steps: Enter email, code and account password; attempt login.
cases.expected: Email becomes verified; login still requires manager approval.

cases.steps: Settings > Team > Approve > Confirm access change. Sign in as new user.
cases.expected: User becomes active staff and can open the workspace.

cases.steps: Manager requests ACTIVE via API.
cases.expected: Rejected until email verification succeeds.

cases.steps: PATCH another user access with staff cookie.
cases.expected: 403; target permissions stay unchanged.

cases.preconditions: Active staff account and current session.
cases.steps: Manager changes role to MANAGER; call API with old session, then log in again.
cases.expected: Old session returns 401; new session reports MANAGER.

cases.steps: Manager disables the account in Team; reload its workspace.
cases.expected: Access ends; login is denied until re-enabled.

cases.steps: Request changing own role or status through access API.
cases.expected: Rejected with instruction to ask another manager.

cases.steps: Click Sign out; retry a protected request with the old cookie.
cases.expected: Login screen shown; old token rejected.

cases.steps: Change Full name; Save profile; reload.
cases.expected: Name persists; login ID/email remain unchanged.

cases.steps: PATCH profile with name plus role field.
cases.expected: 400; profile route cannot alter permissions.

cases.preconditions: Verified disabled account and another manager.
cases.steps: Manager activates account via API; sign in again; test old token.
cases.expected: New login succeeds; old tokens remain invalid.

cases.scenario: Two managers changing each other concurrently
cases.preconditions: Two verified active managers in disposable database.
cases.steps: Simultaneously demote/disable each other.
cases.expected: At least one active manager remains; conflicts are handled.

cases.steps: Request reset; read six-digit code from local mail.
cases.expected: API never returns code; mail contains a usable code.

cases.steps: Request reset for each once.
cases.expected: Same generic message; response does not directly confirm account existence.

cases.preconditions: Verified approved user; second active session.
cases.steps: Forgot password > code > matching strong new password > Update password.
cases.expected: New password logs in; old session returns to login.

cases.steps: Submit incorrect code. Inspect attempts count.
cases.expected: 400; failed attempt is recorded; password unchanged.

cases.steps: Submit the same code again with another password.
cases.expected: Rejected as already used.

cases.steps: Submit otherwise valid reset.
cases.expected: Rejected; password remains unchanged.

cases.preconditions: Pending account; intercepted local test code.
cases.steps: Submit five wrong codes, then the correct one.
cases.expected: All attempts after the limit reject; a new code is needed.

cases.steps: Use it on reset-password endpoint.
cases.expected: Rejected because code purpose is different.

cases.steps: Submit the previously valid code after expiry.
cases.expected: Verification rejected.

cases.steps: Request resend immediately; after simulated 61s request again.
cases.expected: Immediate request returns 429; replacement consumes old challenge.

cases.preconditions: Mail transport fails in controlled API test.
cases.steps: Register; inspect pending account and challenges; restore transport and resend.
cases.expected: No access, failed challenge consumed, resend succeeds.

cases.steps: Enter six-digit invalid code and matching strong password.
cases.expected: Useful invalid/expired/used error, with entered values retained.

cases.steps: Exceed allowed forgot-password requests.
cases.expected: 429 after configured limit.

cases.preconditions: Owner locally configures Gmail app password.
cases.steps: Run node scripts/check-email.cjs.
cases.expected: Authenticated TLS connection; no credentials printed and no message sent.

cases.preconditions: Gmail configured; recipient controlled by tester.
cases.steps: Register real address; check inbox/spam; enter received code in app.
cases.expected: External email arrives; verification and approval work.

cases.preconditions: Approved real account and configured sender.
cases.steps: Use Forgot password; complete reset using external inbox.
cases.expected: Correct reset message arrives and code works once.

cases.scenario: SMTP outage and network timeout in UI
cases.steps: Request code; wait for bounded timeout; restore sender and resend.
cases.expected: Useful failure, no false success, recovery possible.

cases.steps: Use dashboard filters and View all operations.

cases.steps: Read headings, validation errors, statuses, data tables and dialogs.
